notes.title: Achievements for Urban Mage!
notes.notes:
Killing people? Destroying cars? Uncovering all the hidden interactions? Getting 100 combo? Your efforts will no longer be overlooked, you can get Steam achievements now!

18 achievements are now available and more will be coming. There is something for everyone, be it a new player just getting into becoming the evil Urban Mage or a seasoned player aiming to beat the highest community score!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes: We fixed a crucial bug with Steam Leaderboards in Random Challenge Mode which was causing duplicate records. We also fixed a problem with not refreshing the leaderboard right after the game finished and some other smaller bugs!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Exploration Mode Fixes
notes.notes: A quick fix for Exploration Mode where multiple interactions wouldn't be counted properly for some interactible objects.

notes.title: First look at Urban Mage - Can you kill them all?
notes.notes:
Urban Mage is a casual score-based hidden-object clicker game where you play as an all-mighty mage who can kill people with just a single click and who can bring chaos into the city by interacting with various objects! Can you keep the combo? Can you kill them all? Can you find all the hidden interactions?

Zuzana, one of the two developers of the game, will play and comment it while also trying to beat her best score!
